buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of work : 1. Supply of High Purity Argon gas of purity 99.9995% by refilling in Depart ment owned Movable Cylinder Packs(MCPs) of gas capacity 120 cubic meter at 200 bar wor king pressure : Quantity 3600 Cu.m 2. Supply of High Purity Argon(99.9995%) plus 2.5 % Hydrogen mixture by refilling in Depa rtment owned Movable Cylinder packs of gas capacity 28 cubic meter at 150 bar working p ressure : Quantity 224 Cu.m. General conditions: 1. Bank Guarantee for VSSC cylinders: Bank Guarantee should be submitted for cylinders i n each batch costing Rs.6,57,700/-. 2.All checks that are required on cylinders prior to and after filling are to be carried out by you as per explosive rules & ensure safe handling during transit. 3.Gas purity certificate should be provided along with the supply. 4.The cylinder shall be fitted with appropriate valve. 5.Cylinder with valid pressure test certificate only shall be used for filling the gas. 6.The supplier must possess the necessary certified facilities for the testing and refilling of MCPs as per Gas Cylinder Rules and IS 5844. 7.The re-filling process, including collection and delivery, shall be completed within 15 days from the date of issue of the MCP as free-issue material. 8. All testing, certification and logistics are the sole responsibility of the supplier. The quote d price shall be inclusive of

a) All mandatory testing of cylinders/MCPs as per IS standards. b) Collection of MCPs from VSSC premises. c) Transportation to the filling station and delivery back to VSSC. d) Loading and unloading at the refilling station. Other Terms and Conditions: 1. For any clarification regarding the bid, you may contact pso1_mme_pur@vssc.gov.in 0471 256 3577 Quoting ref no.6023 2026 00 3445 01 2. Compliance matrix against the Technical T&C shall be provided by you. 3. Declaration on land border sharing as per the attached format shall be provided in your company letter head. 4. Suppliers shall go through the instructions to bidders as attached. 5. VSSC is eligible for concessional rate of tax@5% under slno.462 (Chapter 88 or any other chapter) of schedule-I of notification no.09/2025 Central tax (rate) dated 17.09.2025 and IGST in term of notification no.09/2025 -Integrated tax (rate) dated 17.09.2025. Necessary IGST/CGST/SGST concession certificate shall be issued by us. 6. Kindly download the technical specification document and convey your compliance against each specification requirement. 7. Your quoted price shall be inclusive of GST. 8. Explicitly mention the percentage of tax included in the quoted price. . 3.
